routes.name: Temporary residence permit (highly qualified specialist in culture)
Work permit and temporary residence permit

note: Azerbaijan, read on the State Migration Service's own pages (migration.gov.az, 'Temporary and permanent residence' and 'Work permit', setting out the Migration Code) on 2026-10-30. A temporary residence permit is issued by the Service on grounds that include being a highly qualified specialist in economy, industry, military, science, culture, sports and so on (with the inviting body's justified application, read as work for the sponsor), engaging in entrepreneurship (no work permit needed: work at anything), or holding a work permit, which the employer obtains for its own workplace only; it is issued for up to one year (three for investors and highly skilled migrants) and extended each time for up to two; the work permit is issued for one year and extended for up to a year at a time, the employer applying 30 days before expiry. Applications are made to the Service in Azerbaijan (in country; the Service also takes electronic applications). Permanent residence may be granted to one temporarily resident at least two years on grounds including being a highly qualified specialist or an entrepreneur (2 kept as those routes' years to it; a work permit holder isn't among its cases); it is issued for five years and extended for five without limit; its holder needs no work permit. Processing times and fees follow the Law on State Fee, not read, so none are kept. Art workers, coaches and athletes invited to sport clubs and registered with the Ministry of Justice need no work permit. Naturalisation's years aren't on the pages.

sources.title: State Migration Service of Azerbaijan, Temporary and permanent residence
sources.said: Permit for temporary residence on the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan is issued to foreigners and stateless persons by the State Migration Service of the Republic of Azerbaijan. ... In case they are highly qualified specialists in the spheres of economy, industry, military, science, culture, sports, etc.; ... In case they engage in entrepreneurship activity in the Republic of Azerbaijan; ... In case they obtain work permit in a way envisaged by this Code to carry out paid labor activity on the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan; ... Permit for temporary residence on the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan is issued for the period mentioned on the application of an applicant, but for the period not exceeding 1 year, except the cases set forth in Article 45.1.2 and 45.1.4-1 (concerning highly skilled migrants) of the Migration Code, and it can be extended each time for the period not exceeding 2 years, if there is a relevant ground. ... Foreigners and stateless persons temporarily residing at least 2 years on the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan on the grounds set forth in Articles 45.1.1-45.1.7 of the Migration Code ... Permit for permanent residence in the Republic of Azerbaijan is issued for the period of 5 years. At least 3 months before the expiration of this period the permit issued for permanent residence can be extended for 5 years upon application of foreigner or stateless person. The number of extensions is not limited.

sources.title: State Migration Service of Azerbaijan, Work permit
sources.said: should employ foreigners and stateless persons only in their own working place and should conclude a labour contract in compliance with validity period of the work permit. ... Work permit is issued for 1 year or in case the labour contract is concluded for a period of less than 1 year it is issued for that period. Validity period of the work permit can be extended each time for not more than 1 year ... those who possess permanent residence permit in the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan; ... those engaged in entrepreneurship activity in the territory of the Republic of Azerbaijan; ... art workers, coaches and athletes invited to work in sport clubs and registered at relevant executive authority (The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Azerbaijan);
